input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position. The cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of (a) Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve months preceding the event and (b) USD 1,000,000. Section 21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, with helpful direct-damage carve-ins for data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident response. Section 21.3 defines "Excluded Claims" (which sit outside both the cap and the damages exclusion) to cover breach of confidentiality, data-protection or security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement/misappropriation of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. "Fees" (§1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is meaningful rather than illusory; §21.4 preserves independence and survival of each cap and exclusion, and §18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No competing or one-sided cap appears elsewhere in the document. No redline needed.
